novel_features.name: VDO.Ninja Guest Management
novel_features.description: Add and remove VDO.Ninja remote guest video sources with automatic WebRTC URL generation
novel_features.rationale: No existing OBS CLI manages VDO.Ninja guest feeds with room-based URL construction

novel_features.name: Production Layout Builder
novel_features.description: One-command scene layout construction for interview, solo, screenshare, and BRB formats at 1080p/60fps
novel_features.rationale: No existing CLI builds full interview/screenshare layouts with correct item transforms — requires programmatic SceneItemTransform calls

novel_features.name: Pre-Show Preflight Check
novel_features.description: Comprehensive readiness gate: connection, mic mute state, stream/record status, visible sources
novel_features.rationale: No existing CLI bundles all pre-show checks into a single go/no-go command

novel_features.name: Agent-Optimized Output
novel_features.description: All commands support JSON output and structured error codes for agent orchestration
novel_features.rationale: Existing OBS CLIs are human-only; this CLI is built for agentic live production workflows

gaps: obs-cli only supports OBS WebSocket v4 (not v5)
No existing tool manages VDO.Ninja guest feeds
patterns: goobs Go library for type-safe WebSocket v5 protocol
Cobra CLI framework for subcommand structure
protocol_note: OBS Studio uses WebSocket v5 protocol (not REST/OpenAPI). CLI uses the goobs Go library (github.com/andreykaipov/goobs v1.8.3) for type-safe protocol access.
